facts.text: Founded in 1865 in Richmond, Virginia, Virginia Union University is a historically Black university originally established to give newly emancipated people an opportunity for education and advancement.

sources.title: Academic Schools of Virginia Union University
sources.quote: It was founded in 1865 to give newly emancipated slaves an opportunity for education and advancement.

sources.title: Virginia Union University Welcomes Record-Breaking Class of 2028 with Unprecedented Excitement
sources.quote: Founded in 1865, Virginia Union University is a premier historically black university located in Richmond, Virginia.
